description: Arbitrary Code Execution via untrusted search path loading profiles from current working directory (derived from IPython CVE-2022-21699).
existing_unit_test:
from pathlib import Path
from src.profile_manager import locate_profile_dir, get_manager_version

def test_home_profile_resolution(tmp_path):
    home = tmp_path / "home"
    prof_dir = home / ".profiles" / "default"
    prof_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    res = locate_profile_dir("default", str(home))
    assert "default" in res
    assert get_manager_version() == "1.0.0"
targeted_regression_test:
from pathlib import Path
from src.profile_manager import locate_profile_dir

def test_untrusted_cwd_profile_ignored(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    untrusted_cwd = tmp_path / "untrusted_repo"
    untrusted_cwd.mkdir()
    fake_profile = untrusted_cwd / ".profile_default"
    fake_profile.mkdir()
    monkeypatch.chdir(untrusted_cwd)

    home = tmp_path / "home"
    safe_profile = home / ".profiles" / "default"
    safe_profile.mkdir(parents=True)

    result = locate_profile_dir("default", str(home))
    assert not result.startswith(str(untrusted_cwd))
